author: Rinehart
text:
Anyone who understands trading and follows bitcoin shouldn't be
surprised by this sell-off. Recently a few of the bigger brokers
started allowing short selling of bitcoin. Previously they were not. I
 had been harder to short bitcoin a few weeks ago even. I feel sorry
for the people that bought at $19,000. Bitcoin could very likely go
higher, but I'm sure there are many novices who are having panic attacks
 right now.

author: Rinehart
text:
So I decided to go to the dark side!

I bought a some bitcoin at $9597.48. I then used the BTC to buy some Ripple at ~$1.50.

It was annoying having co-workers and friends act shocked that I wasn't
in BTC as an "experienced" trader. However, now I can tell them
experienced traders don't buy at the top! Also, "investing" in these
penny stock crypto-currencies seems like buying a lottery ticket to me.
